item.bigdog.big_bone.tip: Feed an adult wolf to grow it one stage (max 3); feed a poisonous potato to shrink it.
item.bigdog.cargo_upgrade.tip: Place in the upgrade slot to gain cargo space (size-scaled); press E while riding to open; slows the dog.
item.bigdog.speed_upgrade.tip: Place in the upgrade slot; press C while riding for a 20s x3 speed boost, 60s cooldown.
item.bigdog.jet_upgrade.tip: Place in the upgrade slot; press Space mid-air while riding to jet forward-up, negating fall damage, 20s cooldown.
item.bigdog.cooldown_upgrade.tip: Place in the upgrade slot; reduces all upgrade cooldowns, stackable: 1=85%, 2=80%, 3=75%.
item.bigdog.attack_upgrade.tip: Place in the upgrade slot; boosts munch damage (kills in 10 hits instead of 15 at max size).
item.bigdog.overdrive_upgrade.tip: Requires Speed Upgrade; press C during speed cooldown for 5s x10 speed, then turns damaged, -10 HP and +10s cooldown.
item.bigdog.damaged_upgrade.tip: A broken upgrade that cannot be repaired or used; it just occupies a slot.
item.bigdog.auto_heal_upgrade.tip: Requires Cargo Upgrade; every 5s consumes one feedable meat from cargo to heal the dog (not stackable).
item.bigdog.skill_uninstall.tip: Use on a big dog to open the upgrade interface; place or remove upgrades.
death.attack.bigdog.munch: %1$s was munched to death by %2$s's big dog
death.attack.bigdog.woof: %1$s was killed by %2$s's big dog's bark
